interpretation.text: Leading 8-dimensional subspace ends at the largest pooled gap (lambda_8/lambda_9 = 2.76). Its largest half-to-half principal angle is 12.5 deg; random 128/128 splits give 14.5/18.5/23.6 deg (5/50/95%). For k<8 the smallest null median is 59.4 deg, so individual leading eigenvectors and the k<8 subspaces are not identifiable at n=128; the 8-dimensional subspace is the stable object. Pooled lambda_1/lambda_8 = 2.34 exceeds the exactly-degenerate-block 95% quantile 2.03 (n=256), so the leading block has a resolved spread and is not called degenerate.

Shell-monopole residual means have z = -13.50, -5.13, 0.07, -1.56 (shells 0-3); 4-D monopole T^2 = 345.9 (zero-mean expectation 4.08). Over the leading 8 principal directions T^2 = 7.45 (expectation 8.29); 98.5% of the 36-D T^2 = 640.0 lies beyond the leading 10 directions (condition number 2.31e+04). Site means by radius: 0-60 Mpc/h -7.31 km/s (z -11.4); 60-100 Mpc/h -6.47 km/s (z -6.6); 100-150 Mpc/h -1.14 km/s (z -0.9); 150-200 Mpc/h -4.48 km/s (z -1.7). FFT 16 vs 24 at fixed radial/ell: monopole-difference Welch z = -4.03, -1.12, 1.78, 2.24; the offset changes with FFT resolution, so it may be partly numerical and is not attributed to a physical near-field monopole.

axis_radial48_vs_main.statement: radial48 vs main: trace ratio 1.0001 (paired 95% 0.9995-1.0007); R105-definition quadratic shift -0.08 (paired 95% -0.17 to +0.00) at matched seeds 1-128. Not resolved by the paired bootstrap at this seed count; convergence beyond the tested value is untested.
axis_radial48_vs_main.residual_mean_note: Same seeds and FFT field as the main run: not an independent confirmation.

axis_ell12_vs_main.statement: ell12 vs main: trace ratio 1.0210 (paired 95% 1.0181-1.0239); R105-definition quadratic shift -3.61 (paired 95% -4.47 to -2.66) at matched seeds 1-128. Resolved: a truncation systematic of the base configuration, not seed noise; the base value is not called converged and convergence beyond the tested value is untested.
axis_ell12_vs_main.residual_mean_note: Same seeds and FFT field as the main run: not an independent confirmation.

claim_classes.quadratics: conditional descriptive statistic (fixed CF3-calibrated growth and bulk; no calibrated p)
claim_classes.residual_mean_systematic: numerical-or-model systematic of the CORAS residual draws; FFT dependence is tested only by the probe runs; no physical attribution
claim_classes.leading_subspace: numerical convergence in the number of seeds
claim_classes.axes: numerical convergence in radial/ell truncation at fixed FFT and seeds

scope: Conditional CORAS realization scatter given the 2MRS constraints at the CF3-calibrated growth (f sigma8 0.405) and bulk (95, -172, 28) km/s; quadratic forms are descriptive.

review_corrections.change: Quadratic keys renamed to state the subtracted mean (quadratic_obs_minus_ensemble_mean_meas_plus_sample_cov); the R105 analytic-mean version, the C(1+1/n)-inflated version and both measurement-only quadratics are reported beside it; the residual mean is reported as a systematic (per-coefficient z with Wilcoxon and sign-flip p, shell-monopole and leading-PC T^2, trailing-PC share of the 36-D T^2, site means by radius); optional FFT probe runs test FFT dependence; the docstring no longer implies zero-mean residuals.

Near-degeneracy wording removed; full leading spectrum and gap ratios, principal angles for k=1..8, v1-versus-top-k spans, permutation null of the largest angle for k=1..15 and an exactly-degenerate-block Gaussian check; the stable subspace is identified from the largest pooled spectral gap.
hartlap_factor_sample_only removed; replaced by a Gaussian Monte Carlo debias factor and SD of the meas+S quadratic (Hartlap shown only as a check of the sample-only Monte Carlo).
symmetric_relative_frobenius now uses the mean-norm denominator of coras_reduce.split_diagnostic and is cross-checked against it; a permutation null is reported.

Mesh-axis changes reported with paired-bootstrap intervals for the trace ratio and the quadratic shift (both definitions, split into mean and covariance parts); a resolved change is labelled a truncation systematic and convergence beyond the tested value is marked untested; seed scatter kept for reference only.

run_files (directory, run.json SHA-256, seed range, mean SHA-256) recorded for every input; stale/partial draw sets rejected; atomic no-clobber write with explicit --supersede; script, dependency and geometry digests and the command recorded.
